name: 라돈 변환 분석
description: 사용합니다 the Radon transform 감지하기 위해 directional 아티팩트 and periodic 패턴 나타내는 이미지 조작.
algorithm: Radon Domain Feature Extraction for Forgery Detection
mechanism: Projects image content along multiple angles using the Radon transform, creating a sinogram representation. Manipulated regions produce anomalous directional 패턴 in the Radon domain.
parameters: Angles: 0-179° (1° step), Projection: line integral, Domain: spatial→Radon, Feature: sinogram 분산
source: Mahdian, B. & Saic, S. (2008) — Blind Authentication Using Periodic Properties of Interpolation, IEEE TIFS
useCase: Detecting geometric 조작 and resampling through directional 아티팩트 분석

references.title: Mahdian, B. & Saic, S. (2008) — Blind Authentication Using Periodic Properties of Interpolation, IEEE TIFS

strengths:
• 감지합니다 directional 조작 아티팩트
• Robust to noise
• Complements 주파수 영역 methods
• Can reveal hidden periodicity
limitations:
• 계산 비용이 높음 for large images
• Limited to directional 아티팩트
• Requires careful parameter tuning
• May miss non-directional forgeries
